relations.subject: Arthur Berriedale Keith
relations.role: Regius Professor of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology and Lecturer on the Constitution of the British Empire
relations.evidence: He became Regius Professor of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology and Lecturer on the Constitution of the British Empire in the University of Edinburgh. He served in this role from 1914 to 1944.

relations.subject: Arthur Berriedale Keith
relations.evidence: Keith was educated at the Royal High School, Edinburgh, the University of Edinburgh (MA 1897; DLitt 1914)

relations.subject: Arthur Berriedale Keith
relations.evidence: Arthur Berriedale Keith was known for his friendship and correspondence with Albert Venn Dicey.
